tool_summary: Runs a command or shell with a different root directory, changing the filesystem root the process sees.
platform_notes: Behavior is consistent across GNU/Linux and BSD/macOS chroot for the purposes of this ruleset. Both typically require root privileges to invoke.

rules.description: Changes the apparent filesystem root for the invoked command or shell. Typically requires root privileges, and the wrapped command's actions inside the new root are not visible to commandant.
rules.reversible_note: Reversibility depends entirely on what the wrapped command does inside the new root, which commandant does not inspect.
